page: Microsoft Azure D32ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture and running on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading at 3.7 GHz. System memory totals 128.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a standard general-purpose ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Local storage is directly integrated, consisting of an 1888 GB NVMe SSD, while GPU hardware is not included.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-core and multi-core capabilities alongside high-speed vector instructions. The CPU features AVX-512 extensions (including AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16) and hardware cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA-NI. In synthetic testing, the instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 2006.0 and a multi-core score of 16251.0, both placing in the top quartile. PassMark CPU encryption registered in the top 25% with 38576.24 points, complemented by a strong PassMark memory rating of 2757.75. Uncached memory bandwidth measures 77.97 GB/sec for large-block reads and 55.91 GB/sec for writes.

Application and domain-specific benchmarks show balanced throughput across common enterprise tasks. The instance delivered 44.48 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads and 29.01 GB/sec in static web serving tests. Text and lightweight model processing reflect solid CPU execution, recording 2852.74 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small 135M parameter model. Under larger workloads, such as a 7B parameter model, text generation reached 17.19 tokens per second.

The bundled 1888 GB NVMe SSD enhances cost efficiency by eliminating the immediate need for external attached disks in temporary data processing or caching tiers. Workloads requiring extreme GPU acceleration will need specialized instance families, but the D32ads_v6 is structurally suited for relational databases, Redis caching layers, web application tiers, CI/CD compilation, and data transformation jobs requiring fast local scratch space.
description: Microsoft Azure D32ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine equipped with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 16 physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor at 3.7 GHz. Configured with 128.0 GB of RAM (4.0 GB per vCPU) and a bundled 1888 GB NVMe SSD, it delivers balanced compute and fast local IO without discrete GPU hardware. Supporting AVX-512 and hardware cryptographic instructions, the instance achieves top-quartile performance in Geekbench (2006.0 single-core, 16251.0 multi-core) and PassMark encryption benchmarks. In application tests, it achieves 44.48 million Redis SET operations per second and 29.01 GB/sec in static web serving. The inclusion of high-speed local NVMe storage provides strong resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for IO-sensitive applications, making it well suited for enterprise database hosting, memory caching, software compilation, and scalable web serving.
